[[File:Harry Potter Trading Card Game original logo.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Original Harry Potter Trading Card Game logo.]]
The '''Harry Potter Trading Card Game''' is based on the ''Harry Potter'' series. Wizards of the Coast published it and credited Skaff Elias, Mike Elliott and Paul Peterson with game design.<ref name="harry-potter-rules">[https://www.cardgamecollector.com/images/harry-potter-tcg/Harry-Potter-TCG-Advanced-Rules.pdf Harry Potter Trading Card Game: Advanced Rules], Wizards of the Coast, 2001, credits on PDF page 15. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260222152650/https://www.cardgamecollector.com/images/harry-potter-tcg/Harry-Potter-TCG-Advanced-Rules.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> The base set appeared in August 2001. ''Chamber of Secrets'', the last of four expansions, appeared in October 2002.<ref name="harry-potter-products">[https://www.cardgamecollector.com/harry-potter-tcg/index.html Harry Potter Trading Card Game], Card Game Collector, product list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260520102300/https://www.cardgamecollector.com/harry-potter-tcg/index.html Internet Archive].</ref>

Players duel as witches or wizards, use Lessons to play cards, and use spells or creatures to remove cards from the opposing deck.<ref name="harry-potter-rules" />

== Playing online ==

[[TCGMix]] features [https://diagonduels.com/ Diagon Duels], a separate browser game.<ref name="diagon-duels">[https://diagonduels.com/ Diagon Duels]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107193451/https://diagonduels.com/ Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="catalog" />
